function.arguments: {"observation": "`customer_age` contains 108 values of exactly -1, which the documentation states means 'the customer did not supply an age'. This is a sentinel value, not a real age.", "implication": "The `customer_age` column is not used in the computation of the conversion rate among loyal customers. function.name: note_finding
